scope: Export the current document and selected subpages as one PDF. Uploaded PNG/JPEG images are included; unsupported blocks are marked.
wait: Wait until the document and title are saved, then try again.
failed: PDF export failed. Check document and attachment access, then try again.
order: The current document comes first, followed by checked pages in tree order. Each document starts on a new page.
loadFailed: Could not load subpages. Export the current document alone or try again.
